purpose: Teach: サンプリング/割愛/懸案/編入/確固たる/バックグラウンド/アウトプット/転嫁

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、品質管理でサンプリング検査を強化しろ
lines.en: I want our quality control to strengthen sampling inspection procedures.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. Firm conviction behind each phrase. No rush — letting weight land on 'strengthen'. Shoulders back, voice level steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。冗長な報告は割愛してまとめます
lines.en: Understood. I'll cut the redundant reporting and consolidate the summary.
lines.style: Respectful, focused nod in his voice. Crisp enunciation. Shows he's taking notes mentally. Slight pause before committing—not hesitation, but the brief breath of someone accepting responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 長期懸案の課題に決着をつけろ
lines.en: Resolve that long-standing issue once and for all.
lines.style: Sharp, decisive tone. Light emphasis on 'resolve'—not a suggestion. Leans forward slightly in posture. Expects compliance. Still measured, not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の中途編入を歓迎します
lines.en: Understood. We're prepared to welcome the new mid-career hire.
lines.style: Warm note enters his voice here—genuine. Slightly quicker tempo, showing he understands the implication. Respectful but not stiff. A small human acknowledgment beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、確固たる経営方針を示せ
lines.en: Our company needs to demonstrate a clear, unwavering management direction.
lines.style: Sits back slightly. Slower pace—each phrase gets its own space. 'Unwavering' lands with quiet confidence. This is foundational. The tone of someone setting the standard for what comes next.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のバックグラウンドを尊重します
lines.en: Understood. We will respect each staff member's background and experience.
lines.style: Straightens slightly. Voice carries genuine commitment—not rote. Slower tempo than before, showing this matters. Eye contact steady. The 'understood' is firm but the rest is sincere.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、研究のアウトプットを増やせ
lines.en: Increase the research department's output and deliverables.
lines.style: Back to the sharp, directive tone. Brief, non-negotiable. Slight lean forward. The consonants are clean. This is priority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コストを下請けに転嫁しません
lines.en: Understood. We will not pass costs down to our subcontractors.
lines.style: Final statement—slower, more deliberate. Closes on a note of principle. Slight rise in respect/dignity in his posture. Shows alignment with the direction set. Breath falls naturally at the end.
